definitions.gloss: discharge from military service; leaving the armed forces
definitions.explanation: The act of being released or dismissed from military duty. Used for both voluntary and involuntary separation from the military.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵役|へいえき}→兵役：19964_heieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧{除隊|じょたい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was discharged after completing his military service.

examples.japanese: {除隊|じょたい}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: After his discharge, he returned to his hometown.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{除隊|じょたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He received an honorable discharge due to injury.

notes:
Composed of {除|じょ} (to remove, to exclude) + ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (unit, troop). The opposite of ⟦{入隊|にゅうたい}→入隊：12064_nyuutai⟧ (enlisting). In modern Japan, this word appears mainly in historical contexts (WWII narratives) and in discussions of other countries' militaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除隊|じょたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be discharged from the military
- {除隊|じょたい}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after discharge
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧{除隊|じょたい}: honorable discharge
- {除隊|じょたい}{届|とどけ}: discharge papers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入隊|にゅうたい}→入隊：12064_nyuutai⟧: enlisting — the opposite: joining the military
- ⟦{退役|たいえき}→退役：22030_taieki⟧: retirement from military service — implies a longer career ending
- {復員|ふくいん}: demobilization — specifically returning home after wartime service
